verdict.rationale: Close ships an official MCP server, officially supported across the Claude ecosystem, that gives agents direct read access to Close data. Leads act as accounts, opportunities carry active/won/lost status for spotting open deals, and the Event Log exposes 30 days of change history, so an agent can assemble most of a pre-meeting account brief. The evidence does not show an endpoint or MCP tool for reading recent email content per account; email is evidenced only for sending and as a smart-field count. History is capped at 30 days via the Event Log. Missing for 10: documented read access to recent email threads per lead, history beyond the 30-day Event Log window, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent compiling such a brief.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the MCP server — no code required.
You can think of a Lead in Close like both a "lead" and "account" in the terminology of some other CRMs.
Opportunities have a customizable status (which always has a `status_type` of either `active`, `won`, or `lost`)
Event Log — Query the last 30 days of changes to any object.
Smart fields are calculated fields, like number of emails on a lead.
